name: Oracle Glade
summary: Bloodfeather harpies harry Oracle Glade in northwestern Teldrassil. The sacred woodland holds the ancient Oracle Tree and Teldrassil’s first and most potent moonwell.

sections.title: Heart of the Woodland
sections.body: Between Darnassus and Wellspring Lake, the Oracle Glade shelters a place of communion with nature. At its heart stands the ancient Oracle Tree, magically nurtured, its great boughs shaped like an eagle perched atop a bear. Nearby lies the first and most potent of Teldrassil’s sacred moonwells, bright with Elune’s grace. The Circle of the Ancients and the Oracle Tree watch over the island boughs. The tree sheds bark marked with messages for Archdruid Fandral Staghelm about the World Tree’s health.

sections.title: A Bough Besieged
sections.body: Bloodfeather harpies have made roosts in the glade’s high branches. The aggressive avian scavengers threaten the sacred tree and harass traveling druids, disturbing the moonwell’s quiet. Sentinels from Darnassus struggle to drive them out. As you pass through the northern boughs, tread carefully; harpies strike swiftly near their roosts.

faq.answer: The Oracle Tree is an ancient, magically nurtured tree shaped like an eagle resting on a bear. It watches Teldrassil’s growth and health, shedding bark marked with reports that druids carry to Archdruid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

faq.q: Why are harpies attacking the Oracle Glade?
faq.answer: Bloodfeather harpies have nested in the glade’s high canopies, where they defend their roosts and harass the Oracle Tree. Local Sentinels work to contain them.

faq.q: What is the importance of the moonwell in this glade?
faq.answer: The Oracle Glade’s moonwell was the first and most powerful established on Teldrassil. Its sacred waters channel Elune’s energies to nourish the forest and sustain kaldorei druids and priestesses who draw upon them.

faq.q: Where is the Oracle Glade located?
aliases: how to get to oracle glade
faq.answer: Oracle Glade lies in northwestern Teldrassil, just west of Wellspring Lake. A road south connects it to the main path circling outside Darnassus’s gates.

angles.text: For a night elf, Oracle Glade shows the care needed to bring Teldrassil to fruition. It holds the crown’s most potent moonwell and a silent watcher that sends word to Cenarion leadership.
For a druid of the wild, the Oracle Tree is a living partner in stewardship. Its bark bears written records of the land’s health.
